material_slot_policy: Faceted banded mineral-ceramic for the shell, spires and cleft lining; a tended-surface slot for the thresholds and the cleft apron; amber for the interior glow, the growth seams and the spire veins, which is the only emissive. REL-ART-029 forbids organic smoothing, so every band is a straight-sided prism rather than a subdivided dome.

pending_requirements.detail: Canon gives the Hearth a slow interior glow breath and a cleft settle on delivery, neither of which is geometric articulation, so this blockout is a static mesh. Per the owner's Anchor ruling of 2026-09-07 a static primary structure is acceptable for a blockout but does not close the pipeline's articulated-component requirement. Do not mark this asset compliant until the requirement is implemented or explicitly amended.
pending_requirements.requirement: Articulated components for a structure of this role

binding_requirements: REL-ART-029 (faceted basalt, zero organic smoothing, 2048^2 PBR, amber <= 15.0% surface area)
REL-BLD-016.KA.HEARTH (1,300 health, 800 cm sight, +12 logistics, 5x5 footprint, produces Tenders)

provisional_bounds.basis: confirmed by the owner on 2026-09-07 as this asset's provisional ceilings

provisional_contract.status: PROVISIONAL. Docs/Requirements.md section 18.2 still carries Meridian cards only. The owner confirmed 8,000/3,500 as this asset's provisional ceilings on 2026-09-07 and directed that a dedicated Kharuun card be authored; that card lives in this worktree and has NOT been incorporated into the authoritative requirements. It is not an existing authoritative per-asset requirement and not owner acceptance.

scale_basis.canon: SPEC-BLD-016.KA.HEARTH (Bible line 555): a wide grown dome of banded strata with arched worker hollows, a matter-intake cleft and a crown of rooted adaptation spires

stage_boundary: Editable source and review evidence only. Not a gate pass, not an Unreal integration, not owner acceptance.

states.damaged: one spire's vein dark and a fracture stepping down the front flank; everything else unchanged
states.destroyed: ceramic collapse inward: the upper bands fall and settle, hollows, cleft and spires gone, a rubble ring remains
states.working: the shell whole, five lit hollows, seven spires with lit veins, amber growth seams between the bands
